# Destructive-Operation Safety Checklist: Discard (Revert) Changes

**Purpose**: Test the quality of the requirements for destructive-operation safety, refusal completeness, and the consistency of spec, plan, and contract, before the implementation starts.
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [contracts/operations.md](../contracts/operations.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the confirmation title, text, and button defined for every action kind, including the staged hunk and every singular form? [Completeness, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the state after a partial run defined for every action with an index part, also for Revert file of several files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017, §FR-022, §FR-039]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the visible result of an expired review defined, with its lifetime? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK004 Are the recovery requirements after a crash during a run stated, through the 001 marker and the unknown outcome? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Plan §D10]
- [ ] CHK005 Does the spec require the plan to list each Windows and WSL file fact that the write keeps, and to record each dropped fact as a known limit? [Completeness, Spec §FR-035, §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the requirements for a Revert file selection defined when marks could come from two lists? [Completeness, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the display of a multi-file result with mixed outcomes defined, with a bound on the listed files? [Completeness, Spec §FR-040]
- [ ] CHK008 Are the requirements defined for an `index.lock` that exists during a revert without an index part? [Completeness, Spec Edge Cases, §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the bounds per file and per action stated with numbers, and does each bound have its refusal text? [Completeness, Spec §FR-025, §FR-038]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK010 Is "the bytes that Git's own restore writes" defined as an oracle that tests can apply, given that Arbareto never runs `git restore`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019, §FR-028, Research §R4]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the line-ending rule for restored lines exact for every `ls-files --eol` report, including a line without an ending? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Data Model §6]
- [ ] CHK012 Are "first focus" and "no default button" stated so that a packaged UI Automation test can check them? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "a held R" defined as key repeat events, with the count of modals it may open? [Clarity, Spec §FR-046]
- [ ] CHK014 Is the meaning of "changed after the review" stated as an exact set of bound facts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007, §FR-011]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK015 Do the refusal reasons of spec FR-038, data-model §7, and contract Δ9 name the same set? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK016 Do the per-file outcomes of spec FR-039, data-model §8, and plan D10 use the same names and rules? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK017 Do the staged-lines precondition of FR-016, User Story 4 scenario 3, and the Clarifications answer agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the no-program rule of FR-004 agree with the read gate and the eligibility refusals for `core.fsmonitor`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, §FR-038, Plan §D2]
- [ ] CHK019 Do the WSL owner and group rules of FR-043 agree with plan D9 and research R9? [Consistency, Spec §FR-043]
- [ ] CHK020 Does the hook answer of the Clarifications agree with constitution I and plan note N-1? [Consistency, Spec Clarifications, Plan §Constitution Check]
- [ ] CHK021 Do the bounds of FR-025, contract Δ5, and research R11 agree? [Consistency]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK022 Is each SC-007 budget tied to a named fixture, a run count, and a method fixed before measurement? [Measurability, Spec §SC-007, Research §R12]
- [ ] CHK023 Does SC-005 cover the shell write path, not only the test double? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK024 Does SC-002 state its intended difference from Git's restore for a staged new file? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK025 Can SC-010 be checked objectively through the requirement-to-test map? [Measurability, Spec §SC-010]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK026 Are the exception flows for a full disk, a read-only volume, access denied, and a sharing violation each given a text? [Coverage, Spec §FR-041]
- [ ] CHK027 Are the requirements defined for a second Arbareto instance that mutates the same repository? [Coverage, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the user-visible state of a temporary file that a crash leaves stated, with the rule that Arbareto never deletes it by name? [Coverage, Spec §FR-036, Contract Gaps]
- [ ] CHK029 Are the Revert file rules defined for a staged deletion, an unstaged deletion, a staged new file, and an unborn branch? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, §FR-021]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK030 Are the cases of a link, a junction, or a folder that replaces the file between the review and the run covered? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-034, Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK031 Are path case mismatches on a case-insensitive volume covered? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK032 Is the case of an intent-to-add entry inside Revert all unstaged changes covered? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-029, §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the case of a `.gitattributes` change that gives other attribute values covered for the `.gitattributes` file itself? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK034 Are the accessibility requirements of the modal and the menus stated for a contrast theme and for large text sizes? [Accessibility, Spec §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK035 Is it stated that logs hold no file content and no diff text? [Security, Spec §FR-049]
- [ ] CHK036 Is the response target during reviews and runs stated? [Performance, Spec §FR-048, §SC-011]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK037 Is the dependency of the v0.1.0 package on this feature documented? [Dependency, Spec §Dependencies]
- [ ] CHK038 Are the facts that the probes must prove marked as unverified until then? [Assumption, Checklist requirements.md Notes, Research §R14]
